notes: All 12 views inspected. Cylindrical leather quiver with a brass mouth ring, banded leather body, stitched panels, a brass buckle and an adjustable shoulder strap, holding a bundle of arrows with individually modelled pastel fletchings and nocks. The strap is real geometry that loops correctly in the side and rear views, and the arrow shafts are visible inside the open mouth in the end-on view. Unrigged static prop.
limitations: The arrows are fused into the quiver and cannot be drawn individually.
The strap is static and cannot be re-fitted to a character without rigging.
